name: Lance Uggla
current_role: Vice Chairman, General Atlantic; co-founder and head of BeyondNetZero (GA's climate growth fund); Mastercard director
profile: Canadian-born British financier who founded Markit in 2003 to provide independent credit-derivative pricing, merged it with IHS in 2016 and sold IHS Markit to S&P Global for ~$44bn (closed Feb 2022). Since 2022 he has been Vice Chairman of General Atlantic and leads its BeyondNetZero climate-transition growth fund.
interesting_fact: Markit began operating out of a barn north of London, born from his 1990s habit at TD Securities of compiling prices for illiquid credit assets; post-Enron demand for independent pricing turned it into a ~$44bn business.
deep_cut_fact: Son of a sawmill manager from British Columbia, he gave C$34.1m to his alma mater Simon Fraser University in 2020 for scholarships, the largest gift in SFU's history; his family foundation also funds Zamcog, a school for street children in Zambia.
notes: Energy-transition investor angle (BeyondNetZero) fits the podcast well. Best route is via General Atlantic.
